title: 54-Year-Old Man Hoisted by Coast Guard Near Tarpon Springs, Fla.
description: A 54-year-old man was medically evacuated by the Coast Guard 15 miles northwest of Tarpon Springs, Fla., Wednesday, April 2, 2014. A Coast Guard aircrew aboard an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter from Air Station Clearwater hoisted the diver and transported him to Tampa General Hospital for further care. U.S. Coast Guard video
